item.title: N15 Lifford Bridge operating single lane due to inspection
item.description: The N15 Lifford Bridge will have single lane operations today due to general routine maintenance inspection. This will run from 9.30am this morning until 2pm this afternoon. Temporary traffic lights will be in place. Donegal County Council apologises for any inconvenience which this may cause.
